_comment: Inclusive Education -- Early Childhood Education Teachers' Diploma syllabus. First
typeset 2026-10-12. Layout and spelling repairs only: NONE of these rewrites a
competence, an activity or an expected standard, and NO clause is renumbered.
STILL OUTSTANDING -- needs the author, not the typesetter:
* The Year 1 matrix numbering does not hold together, and is set exactly as written:
- two topics are numbered 1.3 (Legal Frameworks and Policies; Learning in Diversity),
so every topic after them is one behind the Scope and Sequence Chart, which numbers
Learning in Diversity 1.4, Differentiated Communication 1.5 ... Assistive Technology 1.10;
- competences often carry another topic's number: 1.4.x.x under Learning in Diversity
(sub-topics 1.3.1-1.3.3, then 1.4.4), 1.5.x.x under topic 1.4, 1.6.3 under topic 1.5,
1.8.1.2 and 1.10.1.x under topic 1.7, 1.7.1.1 under topic 1.8;
- 1.5.1.1 is used twice (topics 1.4 and 1.5);
- there is no topic 1.10: the matrix goes from 1.9 Assistive Technology to 1.11 Action
Research, while the chart files Action Research as sub-topic 1.10.3.
* Year 2: competence 2.1.1.3 sits under sub-topic 2.1.2 (after 2.1.2.1 and 2.1.2.2).
* Learning in Diversity is ONE matrix row holding four sub-topics, six competences and all
their activities and standards, so it runs over a page break; splitting it means
deciding which activity belongs to which competence.
* 1.7.3 Facilitators and Barriers: the first two activities are the same sentence
('Discussing in groups to Identify barriers to Inclusive Education'); the first was
presumably meant to read 'facilitators'. Left as written.
* Possible slips left as written: 'Apply specify strategies' (1.5.1.1), 'budding system'
(twice, 1.5.1), 'Human Rights Mode of Disability' (1.1.4), 'Describing the effects of
Inclusive Education' under climate change (2.2.5).
* Assessment: TOTAL 100% and PASS MARK 40% are typed once, after Year Two.
* Time Allocation reads '2 hours per week / Year 1: - (36 weeks) / Year 2: - (12 weeks)'.
* No ISBN yet.
